column31: REAL SHUTOFF RISK, UNLIKE ST. CLOUD: 15% penalty after the due date plus a Delinquent/Shut-off Notice; if unpaid within the following 20 days, water is SHUT OFF and a $100 reconnection fee is assessed. Balance must be paid IN FULL including the fee before reconnection. No reconnections after 4:30pm or at weekends; after 3:30pm a call-out fee applies. The city states that under the Minnesota Uniform Building Code, a household without water services is required to VACATE the premises. ORDINANCE 43 ADDS: shutoff requires prior mailed notice to the OWNER, and the city may instead certify the overdue bill to the County Auditor with an administrative fee through a hearing and certified roll process, payable before 15 November. So Waite Park can both shut off AND put the debt on taxes.
